verdict.rationale: Composio's docs say a session gives the agent a small, fixed set of meta tools that discover, authenticate, and execute tools at runtime. They name 7 meta-tools, including COMPOSIO_SEARCH_TOOLS, which lets the agent search the whole catalog by task instead of preloading every tool definition. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of runtime search and load behavior and its effect on context size.

support.subject: As an AI agent, I can search and load tools at runtime through meta-tools instead of having thousands of tool definitions stuffed into my context

citations.quote: A session gives your agent meta tools, a small fixed set that discover, authenticate, and execute tools at runtime
Composio exposes **7 meta-tools** that let the agent discover what's available, authorize apps on demand, and execute tools across apps in parallel.
Your agent can discover and use any of them through COMPOSIO_SEARCH_TOOLS.
The agent searches by task and selects a matching tool.
